gloss: to bundle up; to put on many layers

definitions.gloss: to put on many layers of clothing; to bundle up; to dress warmly
definitions.explanation: To wear multiple layers of clothing, typically for warmth. Often implies dressing more heavily than usual in response to cold weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧{着込|きこ}んだ。
examples.english: I bundled up because it's cold today.

examples.japanese: ⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{着込|きこ}んで⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a coat over my sweater and went out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{着込|きこ}んで{雪遊|ゆきあそ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: The children bundled up in many layers and went out to play in the snow.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to wear) and ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (suffix indicating thoroughness or accumulation). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ adds the nuance of putting on clothes in abundance or layers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{着込|きこ}む: to dress in thick layers
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧{着込|きこ}む: to put on lots of layers
- ⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{着込|きこ}む: to wear many layers
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{着込|きこ}む: to bundle up properly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}→重ね着：26975_kasanegi⟧: layering clothes — a noun describing the fashion or practice of wearing layers
- ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear, put on — basic verb for wearing; no implication of multiple layers
- ⟦{羽織|はお}る→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧: to throw on, drape over — putting on a single outer garment casually
